body.html:
Benchmark framework · evolving tournament

The context-compression benchmark — an evolving strategy tournament

strategy matrix · sensitivity-tagged tasks · review → rank → vs · self-evolving generations

The goal is a routing policy, not a single winner
Thesis: more relevant context in fewer tokens. We deliver each task's context by many strategies — pure text, pure image at several densities, hybrid (code exact + metadata optically packed), with and without extra relevance data — score them on real tasks, and let agents rank the arms and evolve the next generation. The output is a policy: content-sensitivity → best strategy, because code and prose want opposite answers.

The strategy space (generation 1 arms)

An arm is one point in modality × density × enrichment (later: packing × ensemble). enrichment=full adds relevance metadata — reach, edges, intention — that a bare file lacks.

ArmModalityDensityEnrichmentApplies to
T-baretext—bareall
T-fulltext—fullenrichable
I100-bareimage100bareall
I60-bareimage60bareall
I45-bareimage45bareall
I33-bareimage33bareall
I45-fullimage45fullenrichable
H45-fullhybrid45fullenrichable
H33-fullhybrid33fullenrichable

Metric of record

• Quality-per-1k-tokens. correct answers ÷ (input tokens / 1000). Rewards packing more usable context into fewer tokens.
• Cheap-and-wrong is a trap, not a win. An arm that is cheap but silently wrong on verbatim content is disqualified for that sensitivity — the ranking agent is told this explicitly.
• Token cost is exact. images (⌈w·h/750⌉), text (chars/4). Time proxied by tokens; per-agent wall-clock isn't cleanly measurable here.

Tasks & sensitivity classes

Each task is tagged by what kind of reading it demands. Sensitivity, not task identity, is what the routing policy keys on.

TaskSensitivityEnrichable?
t1_extractverbatim-lono
t3_hashverbatim-hino
t2_logcountaggregateno
t4_summarizegistno
c1_reachmulti-hop-reasoningyes
c2_intentiongistyes
c3_blastmulti-hop-reasoningyes

Generation-1 token ledger (live)

Cost per cell as tokens/multiplier (multiplier = bare-payload text tokens ÷ this arm's tokens; >1 means cheaper than bare text). Blank = arm not applicable to that task.

TaskT-bareT-fullI100-bareI60-bareI45-bareI33-bareI45-fullH45-fullH33-full
t1_extract41/1.0×—117/0.3×42/1.0×24/1.7×13/3.1×———
t3_hash68/1.0×—69/1.0×25/2.7×14/4.9×8/8.5×———
t2_logcount73/1.0×—67/1.1×24/3.0×14/5.2×8/9.1×———
t4_summarize113/1.0×—118/1.0×42/2.7×24/4.7×13/8.7×———
c1_reach107/1.0×142/0.8×193/0.6×69/1.6×39/2.7×21/5.1×50/2.1×117/0.9×112/1.0×
c2_intention35/1.0×78/0.5×60/0.6×22/1.6×12/2.9×7/5.0×35/1.0×49/0.7×43/0.8×
c3_blast28/1.0×46/0.6×37/0.8×13/2.1×8/3.5×4/7.0×15/1.9×35/0.8×32/0.9×
The thesis, already visible in cost
On code tasks the enriched-optical arm carries more data at fewer tokens than bare text: c1_reach is 107 tok bare-text vs 50 for I45-full (2.1×) — the relevance metadata that costs +33% as text (T-full 142) costs less than bare once optically packed. Whether the model can still use it is what the quality run decides. Hybrid keeps code exact but pays a safety premium.

The generational loop

One generation = one pass, then the registry mutates:

• Solve. one solver per (task × arm); reads text / image / both (hybrid); answers only from the context.
• Score. objective (exact / numeric / set-match) against a hidden key — proofs; the gist tasks by a judge.
• Review. one review agent per strategy: strengths, failure modes, which sensitivities to trust it for.
• Rank. a ranking agent builds the leaderboard, the per-sensitivity routing policy, and interesting head-to-head "vs" matchups that each isolate one variable (enrichment, density, hybrid-vs-pure-image).
• Evolve. a meta-analyst proposes new arms + new tasks and retires dominated ones. Next generation runs the mutated registry.

Levers queued for later generations: a true 5×8 bitmap font (reach pxpipe's ~4.6× that antialiased Menlo can't), 3-way voting (does redundancy buy back verbatim accuracy?), confidence-gated re-read (solver flags illegible fields → re-serve those as text), and isolating edges-only vs summary-only enrichment.

Pre-registered expectation (the policy we expect to converge on)

SensitivityExpected best armWhy
gist / aggregateI33 / I45survives deep compression; cheapest
verbatim-hi (hash, key)T-bareoptical confabulates high-entropy strings
verbatim-lo (email)I45 / T-bareborderline; density decides
code / multi-hopH45-fullcode exact + relevance packed = ceiling raised, cost controlled

Persistence & tendencies

Every generation appends to a results.jsonl leaderboard and regenerates a results paper, so tendencies accumulate over a long run. Each such paper is itself render-audited (TUI + Email) — the substrate must be perfect on every surface, since these are the file-documents agents will consume.

Status — ready to run generation 1
47 cells materialized (7 tasks × applicable arms), token ledger computed, workflow drafted (gen.wf.js). A launch runs 47 solvers + per-arm reviews + ranking + evolve, and returns the leaderboard, the routing policy, the vs matchups, and the generation-2 proposal.

Companions: thesis + fidelity results in optical-compression-text-as-image-tokens; the first chore-task protocol in optical-compression-experiment-protocol.
